name: Lip Gellsalk Senglucul
original_name: リップ・ゲルソーク・ゼングルクル
source: The main protagonist. As a kid, she was selected as the queen candidate and traveled to the human world from the demon world to study magic. She grows up to fight demonic tentacle beasts in the second part of the story.
